description:
Problem. Every CI selection excludes `resource_heavy` (ci.yml fast and medium, nightly-v2 fast and slow). On develop 9b72ca3624 the marker selects 56 tests (with `slow`: 760). They run only when someone runs the t3 stage locally through `make heavy-run`, so a regression in them is found late or never.
Expected outcome. Each resource_heavy test has a known place and cadence where it runs and fails loudly.

## Decision gate
(owner; agent must not pick): (1) run them nightly on a GitHub-hosted runner, as a new domain or inside the slow domain from nightly-slow-tier-test-failures-reported-as-success-20261119; (2) run them only locally, at a fixed cadence (for example before each minor release) recorded in the release guide; (3) re-mark tests that fit a hosted runner as `slow` and keep the rest local-only. Agent first measures: per-test duration and peak memory on one `ubuntu-latest` run (dispatch, not a nightly), recorded in context with the run id, before asking.

## Guardrails
- Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`, `make agent-write-preflight`); never edit the primary clone.
- No skip, xfail, rerun marker, raised timeout or weakened assertion to turn a check green.
- Heavy work only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point; no admission or watchdog override.
- No live vendor cloud without owner approval in the task.
- No explanatory comments or docstrings (`make comment-policy-check`); user-facing changes add a `changelog.d/` fragment.
- Anchors (file:line, run ids) are orientation from 2026-11-19; re-read before editing and stop to update the item on a mismatch.
- A hosted job must fit the runner (16 GB).
- Do not re-mark a test to escape the marker without the measurement.
